fusions.name: Lancet Kiss
fusions.desc: A fine bite that deals 3 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pinpoint Shriek
fusions.desc: A narrow shriek across a 4-tile cone ahead of you that deals 12 resonating damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2 tiles. Each target is [Leaden] for 6 seconds, its dodge chance lowered.

fusions.name: Crack in the Shutters
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away. You gain 10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Lap at the Cut
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
